'''''Sclerochloa''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Eurasia]]n and [[North Africa]]n plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/394176#page/181/mode/1up Palisot de Beauvois, Ambroise Marie François Joseph. 1812.  Essai d'une Nouvelle Agrostographie 97-98] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40033542 Tropicos, ''Sclerochloa'' P. Beauv.]</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=129772 Flora of China, FOC Vol. 22 Page 314 硬草属 ying cao shu Sclerochloa P. Beauvois, Ess. Agrostogr. 97. 1812. ]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=sclerochloa+dura Altervista Flora Italiana, Fienarola indurita, Common Hardgrass,  ''Sclerochloa dura'' (L.) P. Beauv. ]</ref> '''Hardgrass''' is a common name for plants in this genus.<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SCLER4|taxon=Sclerochloa|accessdate=8 November 2015}}</ref>

P.Beauv.</small> - [[Europe]], [[Asia]], and [[North Africa]] from [[Spain]] + [[Morocco]] to [[Pakistan]] + [[Xinjiang]]; naturalized in [[Australia]]<ref>[http://bie.ala.org.au/species/urn:lsid:biodiversity.org.au:apni.taxon:398254 Atlas of Living Australia, ''Sclerochloa'' P.Beauv.]</ref> + [[North America]]<ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Sclerochloa%20dura.png Biota of North America Program 2013 county distribution map]</ref>
*''[[Sclerochloa woronowii]]'' <small>(Hack.) Tzvelev</small> - [[Tajikistan]], [[Afghanistan]], [[Iraq]], [[Syria]], [[Caucasus]], [[Turkey]]
